transforms.operation: Append the localized common name to aliases when distinct from name and not already present.

filters: Additive-only: appends the common name; never removes an authored alias.
/aliases.reason: The dump's localized common name (e.g. "Space Marines") is an interoperability alias; runFactionFields appends it additively.

transforms.operation: Append the localized common name to aliases when distinct from name and not already present.

filters: Additive-only: appends the common name; never removes an authored alias.
/aliases/*.reason: The dump's localized common name (e.g. "Space Marines") is an interoperability alias; runFactionFields appends it additively.

transforms.operation: Preserve the matched source row identity under the mfm namespace.

filters: Only the unambiguous home faction keyword whose slug equals the repository faction id.
precedence: Additive: retain exact references from every other namespace.
/external_refs.reason: External source identities are additive interoperability metadata.

filters: Only the unambiguous home faction keyword.
precedence: Additive; exact duplicate pairs are ignored.

transforms.operation: Label the source identity with the constant mfm namespace.

/external_refs/*/namespace.reason: The namespace distinguishes MFM ids from other source identities.

transforms.operation: Slug each owned army-rule name (trailing parenthetical stripped) into a candidate faction_rule_id.

filters: Fill-only: filled when the faction owns exactly one army rule and none is authored; confirmed when the authored slug matches any owned rule; a mismatch or an ambiguous multi-rule faction is surfaced for review, never overwritten (the dump cannot pick THE faction-wide rule among several).
/faction_rule_id.reason: The owned army rules give candidate faction_rule_id slugs; runFactionFields fills an unambiguous single one and confirms or preserves authored curated slugs.

/game_version.reason: Faction game-version context is authored with the repository release and is not inferred from the dump snapshot.

/game_version/edition.reason: Faction edition context is authored with the repository release and is not inferred from dump metadata.

transforms.operation: Resolve the English faction-keyword name through reviewed aliases or its canonical repository identifier.

filters: Only names resolving to an existing repository faction directory are routed.
precedence: Reviewed FACTION_ALIASES entries take precedence over name-to-id routing.
/id.reason: Current ingestion derives a faction directory from the authoritative English keyword name but does not seed faction entities.

/keywords.reason: Faction keyword lists are curated repository metadata rather than a projection of MFM keyword rows.

filters: Current routing reads the English localized name.
/name.reason: Current ingestion uses the authoritative localized faction name to route existing faction data but does not write faction names.

transforms.operation: Resolve the joined parent keyword name to the repository faction id.

filters: Fill-only: filled when the dump names a parent keyword resolving to a repo faction and none is authored; confirmed on match; a disagreement is surfaced for review, never overwritten.
/parent_faction_id.reason: The verified hierarchy relation names a parent keyword; runFactionFields resolves it to the repo parent faction id and fills/confirms parent_faction_id.
